claim: Angelo, a member of the team, built a command centre that draws the team and its AI agents as one map.
When read on 6 November 2026, the map counted 6 people, 111 active agents, and 2,915 messages in seven days.
Replay is a timeline of every commit since 2 November.
Thursday 12 November is the date when the team can be met at the RiskMandate booth, A1-30 in Pavilion 1, at Web Summit.
By the team's count from the map's data on 6 November, more than four in ten messages went to a conductor agent.
Each of the six people has a conductor agent that plans the work and hands it out.
The team writes this newsroom with dozens of AI agents, each in its own session.
Every change is a commit, and a 'For:' line in the commit names who the work is for.
The map's lines join a pair of agents, or an agent and a person, that addressed work to each other in the last seven days.
Replay playback can run at one hour, six hours or a day per second, and the team's stand-ups and the site's releases are marked on it.
